headline: Anthropic releases Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2, reporting broad technical gains
summary: Anthropic announced Claude Fable 5.2 for general use and restricted Claude Mythos 5.2 on Nov 9, reporting broad technical gains and a 30-hour, roughly 1,000-agent Lean formalization of Fermat’s Last Theorem. Its newly inspected system card says Mythos 5.2 does not meet Anthropic’s Autonomy-2 threshold for research-staff substitution or dramatic AI R&D acceleration, but records an uncertain AECI slope-change estimate of about 1.88x and weaknesses in open-ended research and coding tasks. Separately, METR’s Nov 5 high-access assessment estimates Anthropic’s lab-level AECI growth at 1.9x since Oct 2025 and judges most current acceleration likely attributable to AI, with substantial uncertainty and major redactions. The lab-level estimate is not a model-specific result or a direct contradiction of Anthropic’s threshold judgment. Benchmark and scientific claims remain mostly first-party and unreplicated.
